title: Derived-homology affine Tor coordinates respect all certified restrictions
statement: Let i:Z→Y be a closed immersion, n≥0, B=i_*O_Z, and Q=i^*H^{-n}(B[0]⊗^L B[0]) for the fixed derived tensor. For an affine U let T_U be tilde over Γ(Y,U), transported to U and then pushed to Y and tensor-pulled to Z; let M_U=Tor_n^{Γ(Y,U)}(Γ(Y,U)/I_U,Γ(Y,U)/I_U), where I_U is the closed-immersion ideal. There is a family t_U:T_U(M_U)|_{i^{-1}U}≅Q|_{i^{-1}U}. For each affine principal inclusion V⊆U there is q:M_U→M_V certified by [new-t2-self-tor-restriction-certificate] over the structure-sheaf restriction ring homomorphism, such that t_U applied to the restriction of selfTorAffineSection_U(x) equals t_V applied to selfTorAffineSection_V(q(x)) for every x∈M_U [new-t2-self-tor-affine-section]. The exterior comparison and ideal-section tuples do not occur.

proof.text: Resolve each affine quotient A/I by projective modules and sheafify its augmentation. Projective terms are summands of free terms and their associated sheaves are flat. Extend to nonpositive cochain degrees; bounded-above flatness gives K-flatness. The augmentation comparison computes the restriction of the fixed derived tensor. Exact associated sheaves commute with homology, and the projective-resolution isomorphism identifies this with the associated Tor module. The ideal annihilates homology, so tensor pullback gives the asserted chart isomorphism. Choose all chart isomorphisms by these augmentation comparisons.

Localize the chosen augmented resolution at f and compare it with the chosen resolution on V. Localization is flat, so preserves exactness and projectivity; the quotient map gives the tensor chain comparison. Its homology map q has the certificate for every pair P,Q: augmented resolution comparisons are homotopic, so replacing P,Q does not change the homology map.

The K-flat augmentation comparison commutes with localization and restriction. Hence the equation holds for every algebraic homology class x. The tilde adjunction unit and tensor-pullback adjunction unit give exactly the explicit sections selfTorAffineSection, and naturality yields the stated equation. Empty charts and zero quotients are included; degree zero uses the quotient augmentation.
